config.label: Data source
config.description: Data source. Leave unset: live VTpass is used when all three VTPASS_* keys are set, otherwise built-in sample data labelled MOCK DATA. Set "mock" to force labelled sample data.

config.label: VTpass API key — with all three VTPASS_* keys set, live VTpass is used by default
config.description: VTpass API key — with all three VTPASS_* keys set, live VTpass is used by default.

config.label: VTpass public key (PK_
config.description: VTpass public key (PK_...) — with all three VTPASS_* keys set, live VTpass is used by default.

config.label: VTpass secret key (SK_
config.description: VTpass secret key (SK_...) — with all three VTPASS_* keys set, live VTpass is used by default.

config.label: Set to https://vtpass
config.description: Set to https://vtpass.com/api for production. Default is the VTpass sandbox, which returns test data.
